nodes.label: Constantinou Hybrid Bayesian Network Model
nodes.author: Anthony C. Constantinou
nodes.rationale: Captures the temporal causal chain Possession -> Shots -> Shots on Target -> Goals scored via Beta-Binomial Hybrid BN conditioned on rating difference to predict 1X2 and Asian Handicap markets

nodes.label: Modified Pi-Rating System
nodes.author: Anthony C. Constantinou
nodes.rationale: Optimised for actual goal difference rather than winning by removing diminishing function Psi(e) and accelerating learning rate lambda by factor k=3 for teams with fewer than 38 matches

nodes.label: Bettor State-Space Model (SSM)
nodes.author: David Winkelmann, Christian Deutscher
nodes.rationale: Models relative betting stakes using a zero-one-inflated beta distribution coupled to a latent AR(1) state process to account for persistent market activity/nervousness.

nodes.label: Bookmaker Implied Probability Regression Models
nodes.author: David Winkelmann, Christian Deutscher
nodes.rationale: Evaluates whether bookmakers adjust in-match implied probabilities prior to the first goal beyond expected goals (xgdiff) and red card status using 1/mintogoal.

nodes.label: Live Betting State-Space Model for Fraud Detection
nodes.author: David Winkelmann, Maya Vienken, Christian Deutscher, Roland Langrock
nodes.norm_label: live betting state-space model for fraud detection
nodes.rationale: Uses a state-space model with a latent ARX(1) process to capture market activity excitement levels and isolate unexplained positive stake spikes for detecting match-fixing in in-play markets.

nodes.label: Deep Neural Network (DNN) Architecture
nodes.author: Farzam Manafzadeh, Changiz Eslahchi, Hadi Nobari
nodes.rationale: Takes 68-dimensional feature vectors through four fully connected layers (256, 128, 64, 1) with Tanh activations and Dropout (0.2) to predict home team Success Score.

nodes.label: Match Outcome Classification via Thresholds
nodes.author: Farzam Manafzadeh, Changiz Eslahchi, Hadi Nobari
nodes.rationale: Applies fixed thresholds tau_low = 4.6 and tau_high = 5.3 to map continuous Success Scores into Lose, Draw, and Win categories.

nodes.label: Success Score Metric
nodes.author: Farzam Manafzadeh, Changiz Eslahchi, Hadi Nobari
nodes.rationale: Combines Expected Goals (xG) and actual scoring results with sigmoid scaling and base parameter beta=0.5 to balance chance quality, conversion efficiency, and avoid outlier domination.

nodes.label: Tactical Play Styles Framework
nodes.author: Farzam Manafzadeh, Changiz Eslahchi, Hadi Nobari
nodes.rationale: Defines 10 distinct tactical styles quantified via FBref match-level indicators to integrate style into predictive models.

nodes.label: Shin Insider Trading Odds Inversion Model
nodes.author: Hyun Song Shin
nodes.norm_label: shin insider trading odds inversion model
nodes.rationale: Separates public bookmaker overround from insider risk protection margin z, solving true outcome probabilities via quadratic root-finding.
nodes.source_file: 温故而知新学习资料/Shin_1993_and_Strumbelj_2014_庄家赔率反向破译算法精要.md

nodes.label: KTH 2024 Betting Exchange Liquidity Study
nodes.author: KTH Royal Institute of Technology Student Thesis
nodes.rationale: Investigates predicting odds movement on betting exchanges using ML models and financial trading indicators under different liquidity regimes.

nodes.label: Goto et al. (2026) Odds-Only and FL-GLM Conversion Study
nodes.author: Kaito Goto, Naoya Takeishi, Takehisa Yairi
nodes.norm_label: goto et al. (2026) odds-only and fl-glm conversion study
nodes.rationale: Develops odds-to-probability conversion methods under the Efficient Market Hypothesis (OO-EPC and FL-GLM).

nodes.label: Multinomial Logit Regression (MLR) for Soccer
nodes.author: L. M. Hvattum
nodes.rationale: Relaxes the proportional odds assumption to allow draw probabilities to be influenced independently, but doubles parameter count increasing risk of overfitting

nodes.label: Ordered Logit Regression (OLR) for Soccer
nodes.author: L. M. Hvattum
nodes.rationale: Assumes proportional log odds across outcomes (win/draw/loss), limiting utility of variables specifically predicting draw likelihood

nodes.label: Hierarchical Bayesian Poisson Football Score Model
nodes.author: Leonardo Egidi, Francesco Pauli, Nicola Torelli
nodes.norm_label: hierarchical bayesian poisson football score model
nodes.rationale: Models scoring intensities as convex combinations of parameters estimated from historical match data and implicit intensities extracted from bookmakers' betting odds.

nodes.label: Beating the Bookies with Their Own Numbers (Kaunitz et al. 2017)
nodes.author: Lisandro Kaunitz, Shenjun Zhong, Javier Kreiner
nodes.norm_label: beating the bookies with their own numbers (kaunitz et al. 2017)
nodes.rationale: Theoretical justification for exploiting market odds consensus probabilities and mispriced bookmaker lines.

nodes.label: Pérez-Blanco & Salmerón (2025) Bayesian Classifier Study
nodes.author: Nicolás Pérez-Blanco, Antonio Salmerón
nodes.rationale: Proposes class-separating discretization tailored for Naive Bayes to predict football fouls (ordinal) and draws (imbalanced).

nodes.label: Mandadapu (2024) Football Match Outcome Forecasting Study
nodes.author: Purnachandra Mandadapu
nodes.norm_label: mandadapu (2024) football match outcome forecasting study
nodes.rationale: Applies ML algorithms (RF, SVM, KNN, XGBoost) to Premier League match outcome forecasting and bookmaker 1x2 odds estimation.

nodes.label: Football Quant Agent Brain
nodes.rationale: Specialized cognition and actuarial model repository designed for self-evolutionary flywheel updates and draw hunting.

nodes.label: Five Hard Red Lines (V3.1 Physical Circuit Breakers)
nodes.norm_label: five hard red lines (v3.1 physical circuit breakers)
nodes.rationale: Strict single-vote veto rules: no true tilted deep handicap (<1.60), identify fake drift, high draw block requires opponent conceded <=0.8, even match requires small goal check (Over 2.5 < 1.75 veto), and high-scoring draw radar.

nodes.label: Karpathy Skill Self-Evolution Flywheel
nodes.rationale: Four-step closed-loop evolution: Pre-Match inference, physical lock-in at T-2h, post-match reconciliation, and pre-match blind-spot audit.

nodes.label: DDD Onion Architecture & System Specs
nodes.rationale: 10/10 pure domain-driven design with Domain, Application, Adapter layers in Chinese naming convention.

nodes.label: Overall Accuracy & Real-time Scoreboard
nodes.rationale: Live aggregated dashboard computing hit rates and performance metrics across prediction days.
nodes.source_file: 分析复盘记录/总准确率.md

nodes.label: Analysis Review Records Manual
nodes.rationale: Tripartite workflow defining life-cycle contracts between AGENTS.md, README.md, and graphify.

nodes.label: solve_shin_probabilities Solver
nodes.source_file: 温故而知新学习资料/Shin_1993_and_Strumbelj_2014_庄家赔率反向破译算法精要.md

nodes.label: Favourite-Longshot Bias (FLB)
nodes.rationale: Empirical phenomenon where longshots are systematically overpriced and favourites are underpriced.

nodes.label: Favourite-Longshot-Bias-Adjusted GLM (FL-GLM)
nodes.rationale: Single-parameter power-law GLM with adaptive intercept ensuring implied probabilities sum to 1 while capturing favourite-longshot bias.

nodes.label: Odds-Only Equal Profitability Confidence (OO-EPC)
nodes.rationale: Converts betting odds without historical fitting by aligning with bookmakers' equal-profitability-confidence pricing objective.

nodes.label: Draw Bias in Odds Conversion Models
nodes.norm_label: draw bias in odds conversion models

nodes.label: Hurdle Log-Normal Stake Distribution Model
nodes.rationale: Combines a point mass at zero with a log-normal continuous distribution to accommodate periods with zero bets placed despite open betting markets.

nodes.label: Literature Index and Topological Network
nodes.source_file: 温故而知新学习资料/README_学习资料索引与经典论文导读.md

nodes.label: Betting Exchange Liquidity Dynamics
nodes.rationale: Analyzes how market depth and trading volume on peer-to-peer betting exchanges influence odds volatility and model predictability.

nodes.label: Technical Indicators (SMA & RSI)
nodes.rationale: Applies stock market trend and momentum formulas to exchange odds time series as a baseline against machine learning classifiers.

nodes.label: Chi-squared Test Feature Selection
nodes.rationale: Filter feature selection method where all features demonstrated p < 0.05 significance.

nodes.label: Random Forest Classifier (Betting Exchange)
nodes.rationale: Achieved highest performance among ML models in betting exchange odds direction classification.

nodes.label: Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE)
nodes.rationale: Wrapper feature selection algorithm evaluated with n=5 to reduce dimensionality.

nodes.label: Relative Strength Index (RSI Classifier)
nodes.rationale: Technical indicator using 14-period lookback and 70/30 thresholds to predict price movement direction.

nodes.label: Simple Moving Average (SMA Classifier)
nodes.rationale: Technical indicator adjusted into a 3-class classifier with n=10.

nodes.label: SVM Match Outcome Classifier
nodes.rationale: Achieved top accuracy (up to 72.67%) on 1-season data, though struggled with the draw outcome.

nodes.label: Egidi Hierarchical Bayesian Poisson Model
nodes.rationale: Combines historical match results and bookmakers' odds via a convex combination of Poisson scoring rates to improve football score predictions and capture betting market information

nodes.label: Dynamic Seasonal Team Attack and Defence Effects
nodes.norm_label: dynamic seasonal team attack and defence effects
nodes.rationale: Assumes seasonal normal distribution centered at previous seasonal effect plus fixed component with a zero-sum identifiability constraint, avoiding static team effect assumptions

nodes.label: Ordered Logit Regression (OLR) Model
nodes.rationale: Commonly used in academic literature to forecast match outcomes; only justifiable when independent variable influence on log odds is proportional across outcomes.

nodes.label: Consensus Odds-Based Betting Strategy
nodes.rationale: Built on the premise that bookmakers possess highly accurate predictive models; exploits mispricings using aggregate market odds rather than competing against them.

nodes.label: Bookmaker Account Limiting / Discriminatory Practices
nodes.rationale: Compensates for market inefficiency by restricting stakes or banning successful bettors, forcing experiment termination.

nodes.label: Bookmakers' Consensus Probability
nodes.rationale: Serves as an accurate proxy (up to constant intercept) for the actual probability of game outcomes, reflecting aggregated forecasting models.

nodes.label: Paper Trading Validation
nodes.rationale: Empirically tests odds availability and latency effects before committing real funds without execution risk.

nodes.label: ELO-Goals Rating System
nodes.rationale: Extended ELO weighting updates by absolute goal margin to capture more nuance than win/loss.

nodes.label: ELO-Odds Rating System
nodes.rationale: Replaces post-match actual outcomes with pre-match consensus betting odds within an ELO framework, isolating underlying team quality from single-match randomness.

nodes.label: ELO-Result Rating System
nodes.rationale: Traditional ELO updating based strictly on categorical match results (win/draw/loss).

nodes.label: Informational Loss Metric
nodes.rationale: Used to evaluate probabilistic soccer match forecasts; equivalent to maximizing the likelihood function.

nodes.label: Clustered Probit Model
nodes.rationale: Corrects for correlated error terms between mutually exclusive win-bet pairs (home/away) within the same match cluster.

nodes.label: DIFFATTEND Proxy
nodes.rationale: Difference in mean home attendance between opponent teams, serving as an empirical proxy for relative club fan base size.

nodes.label: Sentiment Bias in Betting Odds
nodes.rationale: Captures demand distortions driven by emotional fan support; in competitive online markets, odds shift in favor of (rather than against) popular teams.

nodes.label: Passing Network Centrality
nodes.rationale: Constructs team networks from pass events to quantify tactical connectivity and player flow centrality.

nodes.label: PlayeRank Framework
nodes.rationale: Role-aware machine learning scoring framework evaluating multi-dimensional player performance quality over matches.

nodes.label: Wyscout Spatio-Temporal Match Events Dataset
nodes.rationale: Public collection of granular spatio-temporal match event streams (passes, duels, shots) across 7 major competitions to support performance evaluation.

nodes.label: 8-Capas Betting Deduction Model
nodes.rationale: Standard 8-tier deduction framework spanning ODDS benchmark, team profile, micro player API, Poisson probability, root motivation, 6D weighted score, confidence, and final decision.

nodes.label: Relative-Distance Centroid Discretization
nodes.rationale: Assigns continuous elements membership weights to adjacent cluster centroids to capture local variability for Naive Bayes.

nodes.label: Ranked Probability Score (RPS)
nodes.rationale: Penalizes probability forecast errors based on distance between ordinal categories.

nodes.label: Two-Tier Naive Bayes Cluster Optimization
nodes.rationale: Uses a meta-NB classifier trained on cluster quality measures to select optimal discretization configurations for draw prediction.

nodes.label: Weighted Accuracy & Recall (WAP & WAR)
nodes.rationale: Class-frequency weighted metrics countering skewness in binary draw classification (IR 3.02:1).

nodes.label: General Post-Mortem Manual & Blind-Spot Audit
nodes.rationale: Archive of bookmaker manipulation archetypes and 100% pre-match blind spot audit logs.
